import datetime, hashlib, json, pathlib, re, struct
d = pathlib.Path("docs/praesentation/screens")
soll = ["SC%02d" % n for n in (1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12)]
png = sorted(p.stem for p in d.glob("*.png"))
print("pngs", len(png))
print("namen_ok", int(png == soll))
mt = pathlib.Path("docs/praesentation/screens-manifest.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") if pathlib.Path("docs/praesentation/screens-manifest.md").is_file() else ""
q = {e["bild"]: e for e in json.loads((d / "quellen.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))}
umbau = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat("2026-11-05T18:05:36+01:00")
lesbar = breit = zeilen = nach_umbau = 0
for n in soll:
    p = d / (n + ".png")
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    b = p.read_bytes()
    if b[:8] != b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" or b[12:16] != b"IHDR" or b[-8:-4] != b"IEND":
        continue
    lesbar += 1
    w, h = struct.unpack(">II", b[16:24])
    if w >= 1920:
        breit += 1
    sha = hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    z = [l for l in mt.splitlines() if l.startswith("| " + n + " ")]
    if z and sha in mt and re.search(r"\| %d \| %d \|" % (w, h), z[0]):
        zeilen += 1
    am = (q.get(n) or {}).get("aufgenommen_am")
    try:
        if am and datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(am) >= umbau:
            nach_umbau += 1
    except ValueError:
        pass
print("lesbar_ok", lesbar)
print("breit_ok", breit)
print("manifest_ok", zeilen)
print("aufnahme_nach_umbau", nach_umbau)
print("entfall_begruendet", sum(1 for n in ("SC03", "SC04", "SC05") if "entfällt in v4" in str((q.get(n) or {}).get("hinweis") or "")))
'
